`stb_vorbis.h` is the unmodified public stb_vorbis v1.22 (Sean Barrett), copied
from the workspace's existing TH11 portable SDL codec dependency. It is codec
source, not a game asset. Upstream: https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/master/stb_vorbis.c

The complete dual MIT/public-domain license is retained at the end of the
header and separately in `LICENSE`. No game OGG or other original game data is
included in this directory.
